title: 1.4-billion-year-old mushroom fossil in Brazil

tellings.quote: In fact, an intact fossil of a 1.4 billion-year-old mushroom was found in northeastern Brazil.

plain: In an episode about mushrooms, the podcast host Jesse Michels says that an intact fossil of a mushroom about 1.4 billion years old was found in northeastern Brazil. He tells it to suggest that mushrooms are extremely ancient, which fits the episode's playful idea that they might have come from somewhere beyond Earth.
